title: Hayati Pro Max Blue Sour Raspberry Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Hayati Pro Max Blue Sour Raspberry delivers a sharp, tangy fruit vape packed with syrupy-sweet Blue Raspberry flavour. The raspberry note has a tart edge that’s followed by a sugary finish that rounds out the intensity— perfectly capturing the character of a sour blue slushy confection. Made with nicotine salts for rapid absorption and a more comfortable throat hit, this e-liquid is ideal for MTL (mouth-to-lung) vaping with pod kits and starter devices. The 50VG/50PG blend ensures consistent flavour and discreet vapour with every puff. This flavour is part of the Hayati Pro Max Nic Salt range, inspired by Hayati’s own bestselling disposable vapes and now reimagined in a longer-lasting 10ml format—available in 10mg and 20mg nicotine strengths.
